thread.title: Winfield Associates Inc. Has $8.05 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Winfield Associates Inc. Has $8.05 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Winfield Associates Inc. lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.1% during the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 43,474 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,412 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 4.3% of Winfield Associates Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 3rd largest position. Winfield Associates Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,047,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Other hedge funds also recently modified their holdings of the company. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple during the 1st quarter worth $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple during the 1st quarter worth $134,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple during the 1st quarter worth $138,000. Macroview Investment Management LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 220.3% during the 1st quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $151,000 after acquiring an additional 619 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Litman Gregory Asset Management LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 553.8% during the 1st quarter. Litman Gregory Asset Management LLC now owns 1,033 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $173,000 after acquiring an additional 875 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors own 58.54% of the company’s stock.
